stdout:
Update a comment. Use this tool to update a comment.

Usage:
  yutu comment update [flags]

Examples:
# Update comment text
yutu comment update --id abc123 --textOriginal 'Updated comment'
# Like a comment
yutu comment update --id abc123 --viewerRating like
# Update comment text with rating enabled
yutu comment update --id abc123 --textOriginal 'New text' --canRate

Flags:
  -R, --canRate               Whether the viewer can rate the comment
  -h, --help                  help for update
  -i, --id strings            ID of the comment
  -o, --output string         json|yaml|silent
  -t, --textOriginal string   Text of the comment
  -r, --viewerRating string   none|like|dislike
      --yes                   Confirm the operation
